title: The Limits of Price Discrimination When the Market Is Unknown
abstract: arXiv:2610.30408v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Bergemann, Brooks, and Morris (2015) characterize the consumer and producer surplus pairs that segmentation can produce when the distribution of values is known. I fix only the set of possible values and characterize the pairs that some market and some segmentation can produce. They form a convex polygon. Its outer edge is the largest efficient surplus a market can have when its uniform-price profit is capped, net of that profit, and truncated equal-revenue markets attain it. At the values no segmentation is needed; strictly between two values, reaching the frontier requires splitting a market into two extremal markets. With a continuum of values up to $\bar{v}$, consumer surplus is at most $\pi\ln(\bar{v}/\pi)$ when producer surplus (the seller's profit) is $\pi$, this bound is reached without segmentation, and no market gives consumers more than $\bar{v}/e$.

translated_title: 当市场未知时价格歧视的极限
translated_abstract: Bergemann、Brooks 和 Morris (2015) 刻画了当价值分布已知时，市场分割所能产生的消费者剩余与生产者剩余的组合。本文仅固定可能的价值集合，刻画了某些市场和某些分割所能产生的剩余组合。这些组合构成一个凸多边形。其外边界是当市场的统一定价利润受到上限约束并扣除该利润后，市场所能获得的最大有效剩余，而截断的等收入市场可以达到这一边界。在某些价值点上无需进行市场分割；而当利润严格介于两个价值点之间时，要达到边界就需要将一个市场分割为两个极端市场。当价值在直至 $\bar{v}$ 的连续区间上分布时，若生产者剩余（卖方利润）为 $\pi$，则消费者剩余至多为 $\pi\ln(\bar{v}/\pi)$，这一界限无需分割即可达到，且没有任何市场能给消费者带来超过 $\bar{v}/e$ 的剩余。
tldr: 本文将价格歧视下可行剩余组合的分析从已知分布推广到仅知价值集合的未知市场，刻画出凸多边形形式的剩余前沿，并证明当利润为 π 时消费者剩余至多为 πln(v̄/π)。
en_tdlr: This paper extends the analysis of feasible surplus pairs under price discrimination from known distributions to unknown markets characterized only by their value sets, establishing a convex polygonal frontier and proving that consumer surplus is at most πln(v̄/π) when profit is π.
